author: Traditionally John the apostle
authorNote: Traditionally John the apostle. The author calls himself "the elder" in 2 and 3 John; scholars debate whether this is the apostle or another John.
overview: Written to reassure believers after a split in their church, 1 John gives tests of real faith: believing Jesus came in the flesh, obeying God, and loving one another. "God is love."
storyPlace: One of three letters linked with John's Gospel.
